BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsᵉlach is the word for to advance. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including Daniel 3:30 and Daniel 6:28.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsᵉlach is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
